Link URL: Icon: /content/dam/icons/approved-icons/student-group.svg Why undertake postgraduate research us? We are home to an extraordinarily talented group of students and researchers who work directly with our dedicated academic staff, many of whom are internationally renowned in their fields. Our research community creates an environment that is stimulating and equips our research students with the skills and confidence to engage in research anywhere in the world. You will develop highly transferable skills in communication, leadership, management and commercialisation, preparing you to pursue an academic career or move into industry, government or business. Our research into creating a resilient and healthy future for life on this planet spans the following key areas: Our research areas Chemistry Geosciences History and philosophy of science Life and environmental sciences Mathematics and statistics Physics Psychology Veterinary Science Application resources Title : How to apply Description : A step-by-step process for applying for postgraduate research degrees Link URL: https://www.sydney.edu.au/study/applying/how-to-apply/postgraduate-research.html Icon: /content/dam/icons/approved-icons/application.svg Title : Writing a research proposal Description : Follow our guide to produce a proposal that is clear and makes a case for itself Link URL: https://www.sydney.edu.au/study/help/advice/how-to-write-a-research-proposal.html Icon: /content/dam/icons/approved-icons/pen-write-content.svg Title : How to finance a research degree Description : Discover the range of funding options for your tuition fees, living costs and research time Link URL: https://www.sydney.edu.au/study/help/advice/how-to-finance-my-research-degree.html Icon: /content/dam/icons/approved-icons/money-people.svg Find a supervisor ispopup: false Search ispopup: Professional development Your development as a researcher starts during orientation, which includes sessions on drafting literature reviews, preparing research proposals and presenting research developments. Over 270+ coursework units of study are available to you throughout your candidature. Opportunities are also available to grow professionally and academically through a paid 3-6 month internship with an industry partner as you complete your degree. 50 manual Link Support for our research students One of our strategic priorities is to invest in the resources and capabilities of our researchers to support outcomes that have a positive impact on society. As a Doctor of Philosophy (Science) student you will have the following support available: student support and language program for international students, access to a range of workshops and HDR training modules to help give you the opportunity to learn new skills that will compliment your research, and career advice and support to help you explore your career options once you complete your higher degree research degree. I’ve been really lucky to have so many networking and career opportunities throughout my PhD. I’ve done three international conferences and many domestic ones.
